espeak_ng_data: NO espeak-ng-data — Ol Chiki chars are sufficient and avoid GPL-3.0 bloat; dataDir='' at runtime
eval_guard: IN22-Gen/Conv eval-only, never in train; dev/eval held-out 10% of curated set
consent: VOICE_CONSENT.md — CC BY 4.0 corpus consent; single speaker curated per RESEARCH.md single-speaker recommendation
curation_note: Single-speaker curated subset (SAT-IV-SP001, ~3,200 utt, 4.52h) from IndicVoices Santali to avoid multi-speaker collapse on 433-spk Nirantar. If multi-speaker degrades MOS/prosody, single-speaker is retained. All audio resampled to 22.05 kHz mono, trimmed, loudness-normalized.

pipeline.normalize: peak -1 dB, loudnorm EBU R128 optional
pipeline.filter: duration 2–12 s, SNR > 15 dB, Ol Chiki validator

provenance.budget: TTS slice 20–80 MB, model 22.05 kHz mono, sherpa-onnx OfflineTts
